text: INTERPRETER (both engines, S0b-class correctness fix, veto interp.rs:231, eval.rs:1634/1662/1675/1862): Flow::HandlerDone carries the handler-stack index of the frame whose arm completed without resume (boxed with the value, Box<(Value, usize)>, so Flow's layout and the hot path are unchanged), and eval_with_handler catches it only at that depth (the sealed block-value taint reads acc only then). UNSEALED BEHAVIOUR CHANGES: a completion used to be caught by the nearest with, so an inner with handling another effect (same body or a callee) took an outer arm's value and the outer body ran on (107 instead of 7); it now unwinds to the with that installed the arm, and a with it passes through does not run its return arm. The VM lowers WithHandler to one Tree op, so the fix is shared. TEST-ONLY: vm/tests.rs handler_completion_finishes_its_own_with_on_both_engines; M74 re-anchored. Not PCI-reviewed; every sealed run is still refused (SEAL_RUNTIME_COMPLETE = false)
